composition: Apply after exact qemu-instruction-trace v1 source, verifying each preimage hash and git apply --check. Requires QEMU configured with -Dplugins=true.
scope: Schema v2 adds translation-bound x86 TCG code bytes (up to 15) with explicit availability and runtime x86 code-bits/CS selector/effective CS base where the target provider is available. Breakpoint-pre-dispatch has no bytes because no translation has occurred. Bytes are copied after final TB size is set in plugin_gen_tb_end using translator_st over bytes retained by that TB translation; each callback points to an immutable payload in a bounded 65,536-entry slab retained until a stopped-start TB flush. Capture admission requires serial TCG (CF_PARALLEL disabled), so tb_flush completion is synchronous before freeing or replacing the slab, including on machines with max_cpus greater than one. The event remains a pre-execution boundary and makes no decode, completion, or retirement claim. Copy failures, oversized instructions, and exhausted descriptors produce an event with explicit unavailable reason. Non-x86 builds report x86 context unavailable. Reset/checkpoint invalidation clears observations and advances epoch.
